hypothesis: The primary success head is not the only deployable output of the shared representation. A fixed low-capacity logistic head trained on the immediately previous outer season can translate all eight task probabilities into one calibrated success probability, then transfer one year ahead without same-target-fold fitting.

selection_firewall.2021_role: first untouched evaluation of auxiliary-head usefulness

recipe.transform: clip each probability to [1e-5,1-1e-5], convert to logits, StandardScaler fit on prior-season R, then sklearn LogisticRegression
recipe.final_formula: 0.75 * exact_C + 0.25 * temporal_head on R; exact_C unchanged on F

gate_2021.on_pass: Freeze the entire rolling meta-fit recipe, then train fresh base heads for 2022/2023 and always fit the temporal head on Y-1 only.
